Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Diffusion de sécurité?

In this glossary, Diffusion de sécurité refers to: Official VHF or NAVTEX message to all ships concerning safety-related information or urgent warnings.

How is Diffusion de sécurité used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Diffusion de sécurité à tous navires : visibilité réduite en raison du brouillard, signaux sonores obligatoires à l'approche du port."

Why does Diffusion de sécurité matter in maritime?

Diffusion de sécurité matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Diffusion de sécurité?

Diffusion de sécurité is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Diffusion de sécurité belong to?

In this glossary, Diffusion de sécurité is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Official VHF or NAVTEX message to all ships concerning safety-related information or urgent warnings.

Operational example

Safety broadcast to all vessels: reduced visibility due to fog, sound signals must be used in port approaches.

Localized term

Diffusion de sécurité

Localized example

Diffusion de sécurité à tous navires : visibilité réduite en raison du brouillard, signaux sonores obligatoires à l'approche du port.
